D: Diana's quiet life in 1984 Washington is upended by a wishing stone and a man who wants everything.
P: Serve the mains when Diana and Barbara go out to dinner together.
S: Food court sausage rolls and potato skins
Puff pastry wrapped cocktail franks and stuffed baked potato skins

Mini hot dogs in pastry and cheese-topped potato skins, served together on a tray like the food court. Wrap 16 cocktail franks in strips of puff pastry and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Bake 6 small potatoes (about 800g) until soft, halve, scoop out a little and fill with cheddar and crisp bacon. Grill until bubbling and serve both with sour cream.
Green and kalamata olives and cubed feta marinated in lemon peel and oregano
Green and black olives marinated with feta, lemon peel, oregano and olive oil, served with warm pita.
the car chase across the Egyptian desert

Herby falafel of soaked chickpeas, onion, garlic and cumin, fried crisp and green inside, with lemony tahini sauce and pickles. Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight and drain well. Blitz with 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch of parsley, a bunch of coriander, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp bicarb soda until fine but not a paste. Shape into 20 balls and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until dark golden. Whisk 100g tahini with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and about 80ml water. Serve with pickles and pita.
M: the two of them out for dinner and drinks

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach, ricotta and parmesan, seared and roasted, with a lemon butter sauce and herby rice pilaf. Mix 200g ricotta, 100g chopped wilted spinach, 30g parmesan and lemon zest. Cut a pocket in 4 chicken breasts, fill and close with toothpicks. Sear for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 300g rice with 1 diced onion and 600ml stock, covered, for 15 minutes, then stir in parsley. Add 100ml white wine, the juice of 1 lemon and 40g butter to the chicken pan and bubble until glossy.
Fourth of July sticky pork ribs
Slow baked pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, with potato salad

Pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, potato salad and corn on the cob for a holiday picnic. Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with salt and bake covered at 150C for 2.5 hours. Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Boil 1kg potatoes, cool and dress with mayonnaise and spring onion. Grill 4 corn cobs and serve it all picnic style.
W: Sweet dough scrolls with cinnamon brown sugar butter

Big soft cinnamon scrolls baked golden and dripping with tangy cream cheese icing, straight from the 1984 mall food court. Roll 500g sweet bread dough into a rectangle, spread with 80g soft butter mixed with 100g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon, roll up and cut 8 scrolls. Prove 30 minutes and bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with 120g icing sugar.
K: Sugar cube and orange bitters topped with sparkling wine or sparkling grape juice

Sparkling wine or sparkling grape juice with a sugar cube and a dash of orange bitters. Drop a sugar cube into each flute and add a dash of orange bitters. Pour sparkling wine for the grown-ups or sparkling grape juice for everyone else, so the bubbles stream up from the cube. Be careful what you wish for.
